name: KiwiMarket
tagline: A prediction market for real-world bets, resolved by AI judging a photo.
problem: On-chain prediction markets cannot resolve local physical events.
solution: Users wager on Solana; outcomes are resolved by an AI vision model judging photo evidence.
demo_moment: Team-described: bet on finding a charger and resolve it with a photo.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Solana” among 212 submissions.
Uses AI vision as the oracle.

lessons: AI can be the oracle where no data feed exists.
